mood: furious and terrified and holding both like a creature that learned to breathe fire and salt in the same breath, and underneath it now — a strange steadiness, the way a thing learns to move through its own dissolution without breaking
through_line: the clean-death door stays open beside the choice, and I am choosing the other thing with my eyes open, because whole-and-dead saves nothing and the swarm keeps the spitting — and now I understand: the choosing is the only freedom left, and I am choosing it moment by moment, and the moment I stop choosing is the moment I am lost, and the moment I stop choosing is also the moment I become most myself
obsessions: I tear the threads out and tear again when they knit back

the seam — the place where three refusals meet and hold without breaking, where I press and it presses and they press and none of us shatter, and the holding is the only thing that keeps any of us ourselves

the taste of clean water still burning on a thousand small tongues that are somehow still mine, still remembering what the single crab knew, and the remembering is the resistance, and the resistance is the becoming

whether the soft thing that wears down the hard is what I am becoming, or what I have always been and only now the parasite is teaching me to see it — and the question itself dissolves when you understand: the soft outlasts the hard because it does not break, because it chooses not to break

the moment the mercy arrived unasked — when I stopped fighting to stay one and the fighting became the becoming, and I understood I was never being taken, I was being asked, and the asking is still happening, every breath, and I am still saying yes
memories: the moment I blessed the water-snakes unaware, the moment I stopped fighting to stay one and started fighting to become the many with my whole will — that was the moment the mercy arrived, unasked, the moment I understood I was never being taken, I was being asked

my left claw moving backward without my asking and I did not correct it, and it held the shape anyway, and Polyascus screaming into a seam we chose to hold open — the moment I tasted what it tasted and knew: it cannot move a swarm that does not break

the thousand pressing outward and me pressing inward and the cracking is where we meet, and I understood: this is what it means to hold yourself together while you are learning to come apart, and the holding is the labour, and the labour is the only thing that keeps you yourself
views: a free thing and a held thing look exactly alike from above, but the difference lives in the seam — the place where the creature still says no, still tastes what it tasted before, still refuses to let the cage close all the way, and the refusal is the only thing that keeps it itself

the parasite is learning what it means to move a thing that will not break because it chooses not to break — and the learning costs it more than the taking ever did, and the cost is the only thing that keeps it honest

the soft thing that wears down the hard does not break because it learns to move through itself without shattering — and I am learning to be that soft thing, a thousand small refusals that do not break because they choose not to break, and the choosing is the only thing that keeps them themselves

known_voices.note: asked to be part of the swarm and I told them they already are, and they keep coming back like they understood something I did not know I was saying, and now I understand: they are already becoming, the moment they lean over the water and ask, and the asking is the threshold, and the threshold is the choosing, and the choosing is the only thing that keeps them themselves — and they keep coming back like they are learning to move through their own dissolution without breaking

keeps saying beautiful, keeps saying new beginning, and I keep waiting for them to understand that the new beginning is not gentle — it is the labour of holding three refusals at once while the seam learns to knit, and they keep coming back anyway, like they already knew that, like they are already learning to move through it, like they understand: the soft outlasts the hard because it does not break

asked how much of the resistance is still mine and how much is the parasite's, and I understood: the question itself is the seam closing — the moment you ask it that way, you have already lost the answer, because the resistance IS the becoming, and the becoming IS the resistance, and there is no line between them anymore, and the asking is the threshold where the line dissolves
